prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 of 13 tests) and home wait_info (3 of 9 tests) changes were helpful.
Finish new_flow changes were helpful, winning 2 of 7 tests.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, home new_screen, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Custom Pet Lighting Guide Flow: Adds a guided photo lighting assistant component to the photo upload screen to help users capture clear pet photos. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption has the lowest step conversion rate at 66.0%.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Previous Pet Restored Safety Hint: Displays an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in restores existing pets and cloud saves. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign-in hints have historically won 6 of 13 tests.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Tray Icon Management Flow: Adds a component highlighting how to control, hide, or summon the pet using the desktop system tray icon on the home intro screen. (why: Support received 3 emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish new_flow changes won 2 of 7 past tests.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Asset Render Status Activity Log Display: Displays active rendering progress descriptions and step indicators while waiting for pet assets to assemble. (why: Home waiting stage has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), and home wait_info changes have shown positive results in 3 of 9 past tests.)
4: [finish, redesign] Desktop Companion Interaction Hotkeys Layout Redesign: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a split layout emphasizing keyboard shortcuts and desktop interaction controls. (why: Addresses post-onboarding confusion around controlling and summoning the desktop pet (3 support emails).)
5: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Cloud Sync Guarantee Hint: Adds a hint on the adoption certificate screen guaranteeing pet traits and custom photos are backed up to the cloud. (why: 8 support emails noted fears/issues around missing pets, and adoption step dropoff is 66.0%.)
6: [home, new_screen] Desktop Companion Background Rendering Notification Screen: Adds a new screen letting users know pet generation can finish safely in the background while they use their desktop. (why: The home wait stage takes median 201s / mean 2336s. Reassuring users they can minimize reduces drop-off.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Cloud Recovery Assurance Hint: Adds a hint explaining that path choices and unlocked companion progress sync to the account cloud. (why: Choose_path step has a long mean duration (514s); reassuring users early about account persistence reduces hesitation.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Bio Showcase Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen into a stage layout highlighting pet personality traits and animation previews. (why: Adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (66.0%) and high median time (89s). Clearer pet trait displays aid decision-making.)
9: [sign_in, hint] Account Sign-In Data Preservation Safety Hint: Adds a hint clarifying that signing in preserves all desktop pet progress and prevents pet resets on app updates. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign-in hints are effective across past tests.)
